name: prometheus-exporter
title: Prometheus Exporter
description: Runs scross01/prometheus-klipper-exporter as a managed service, exposing Klipper/Moonraker metrics in Prometheus format at :9101/metrics so you can scrape them into Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, etc. The exporter is a small Go binary cross-compiled for the printer in CI and baked into the package; nothing is built on the printer. Observability for people who run a metrics stack; most users will not need it. Experimental, not yet verified on a physical printer.
tagline: Klipper/Moonraker metrics in Prometheus format for Grafana & co.
